template_assisted_hypotheses.candidate_cognitive_job: Convert an intimidating process into a sequence a reader can start and repeat.
candidate_reader_states: desire for a reliable first move
template_assisted_hypotheses.candidate_caption_job: Explain the work moment, trade-offs and failure boundary behind the steps; do not merely transcribe them.
candidate_use_when: A useful outcome genuinely requires ordered actions.
The reader can begin without hidden prerequisites.
The sequence has a real quality check or decision point.
candidate_do_not_use_when: The work is non-linear and forcing steps would mislead.
The post cannot specify a valid first action.
The claim is a broad strategy rather than a process.
template_assisted_hypotheses.candidate_reverse_build_specification: When an opportunity needs a repeatable start-to-finish path, use numbered stages with one action and one visible output per stage. Make progress feel possible, include the point at which the reader must judge or validate, and reserve the caption for context and exceptions.
template_assisted_hypotheses.topic_selection_boundary: This template does not select a future topic, audience, factual claim or post angle.
template_assisted_hypotheses.required_next_step: Inspect the local asset and write record-specific evidence before promoting any candidate field into a manual forensic record or Creative Genome retrieval.
